**1.012: Transcription controls and a separate transcript box.**

- **New recorder controls** in the Transcription tab: round icon buttons in one colour per action (Record red, Pause amber, Stop slate, Retake blue, Discard grey), with Transcribe as a green send arrow. Hover a button for its name.
- **The transcript box is Transcription Mode's alone:** a Voice Typing take no longer pastes into it when it has focus. The take goes to the clipboard and History instead, and the status bar says so.
- Ubuntu 26.04 .deb and a portable Windows zip. Not yet tested on Windows hardware. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
